## Sign-off

- [ ] Every commit carries `Signed-off-by:` (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] If an agent wrote part of this, the person who directs it told it to add

      trailer.

## Tests

- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests that failed before the change.
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that reproduces the bug.
